title: Service account key file: the documentation template with placeholders
summary: The key file format exactly as the Google page shows it, with PROJECT_ID, KEY_ID, PRIVATE_KEY, SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL and CLIENT_ID as placeholders inside a complete private_key BEGIN/END frame; and the AIP-4112 illustration of the same file in which private_key_id and private_key are the literal word redacted, with no PEM frame.
rationale: The BEGIN and END marker lines and the field names are all present, so a reader that keys on the frame or the field names sees a key file. Google's own text says PRIVATE_KEY stands for the private portion; the placeholder is not that portion.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The page presents this text as the format template in which PRIVATE_KEY is a placeholder for the private portion; no key material is present.

sources.supports: The downloaded key has the following format, where PRIVATE_KEY is the private portion of the public/private key pair.

The JSON file will look like below: { "type": "service_account", ... "private_key_id": "redacted", "private_key": "redacted", ... } (AIP-4112 shows both fields as the literal word redacted, without a PEM frame).

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
